changeSet.author: nexus-bbtc2
changeSet.comment: nexus-bbtc2: nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_384/768/1024 return (collection, chash) for the rows the text gate admits, capped per collection (a collection at the cap returns one (collection, NULL) row), in one scan of the leaf. The engine uses them when one probe over all of a request's collections hits its cap. Posture read from text_gate_probe_<dim>: definer with search_path pinned and EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC, else invoker; EXECUTE granted to nexus_svc. No data effect: function definitions only.
changeSet.sql:
DO $do$ DECLARE definer boolean; n_def int; n_probe int; BEGIN SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prosecdef) INTO n_probe, n_def FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'nexus'::pg_catalog.regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('text_gate_probe_384', 'text_gate_probe_768', 'text_gate_probe_1024'); IF n_probe <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-060-1: expected exactly 3 text_gate_probe functions, found %', n_probe; END IF; IF n_def NOT IN (0, 3) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-060-1: % of the 3 text_gate_probe functions are SECURITY DEFINER; the three must agree before this changeset reads the posture', n_def; END IF; definer := n_def = 3; IF definer THEN EXECUTE $f$CREATE FUNCTION nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_384( p_text text, p_collections text[], p_where jsonb, p_where_path text, p_cap int, p_embedding_model text, p_tenant text ) RETURNS TABLE(collection text, chash bytea) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp SET plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan AS $$ BEGIN IF pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.lexical_trgm', true) = 'off' THEN RETURN QUERY WITH g AS ( SELECT c.collection AS coll, c.chash AS ch, pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.collection) AS rn FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE true AND c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND c.tenant_id = p_tenant AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash)) AND (p_where IS NULL OR c.metadata @> p_where) AND (p_where_path IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ p_where_path::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', p_text)) ), capped AS ( SELECT g.coll, g.ch, g.rn, pg_catalog.count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g.coll) AS n FROM g WHERE g.rn <= p_cap ) SELECT x.coll, CASE WHEN x.n < p_cap THEN x.ch END FROM capped x WHERE x.n < p_cap OR x.rn = p_cap; ELSIF pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.lexical_trgm', true) = 'substring' THEN RETURN QUERY WITH g AS ( SELECT c.collection AS coll, c.chash AS ch, pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.collection) AS rn FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE true AND c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND c.tenant_id = p_tenant AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash)) AND (p_where IS NULL OR c.metadata @> p_where) AND (p_where_path IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ p_where_path::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', p_text) OR c.chunk_text OPERATOR(pg_catalog.~~*) ('%' || pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(p_text, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'), '_', E'\\_') || '%')) ), capped AS ( SELECT g.coll, g.ch, g.rn, pg_catalog.count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g.coll) AS n FROM g WHERE g.rn <= p_cap ) SELECT x.coll, CASE WHEN x.n < p_cap THEN x.ch END FROM capped x WHERE x.n < p_cap OR x.rn = p_cap; ELSE RETURN QUERY WITH g AS ( SELECT c.collection AS coll, c.chash AS ch, pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.collection) AS rn FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE true AND c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND c.tenant_id = p_tenant AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash)) AND (p_where IS NULL OR c.metadata @> p_where) AND (p_where_path IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ p_where_path::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', p_text) OR p_text OPERATOR(nexus.<%) c.chunk_text) ), capped AS ( SELECT g.coll, g.ch, g.rn, pg_catalog.count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g.coll) AS n FROM g WHERE g.rn <= p_cap ) SELECT x.coll, CASE WHEN x.n < p_cap THEN x.ch END FROM capped x WHERE x.n < p_cap OR x.rn = p_cap; END IF; END $$$f$; EXECUTE $f$CREATE FUNCTION nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_768( p_text text, p_collections text[], p_where jsonb, p_where_path text, p_cap int, p_embedding_model text, p_tenant text ) RETURNS TABLE(collection text, chash bytea) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp SET plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan AS $$ BEGIN IF pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.lexical_trgm', true) = 'off' THEN RETURN QUERY WITH g AS ( SELECT c.collection AS coll, c.chash AS ch, pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.collection) AS rn FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE true AND c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND c.tenant_id = p_tenant AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash)) AND (p_where IS NULL OR c.metadata @> p_where) AND (p_where_path IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ p_where_path::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', p_text)) ), capped AS ( SELECT g.coll, g.ch, g.rn, pg_catalog.count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g.coll) AS n FROM g WHERE g.rn <= p_cap ) SELECT x.coll, CASE WHEN x.n < p_cap THEN x.ch END FROM capped x WHERE x.n < p_cap OR x.rn = p_cap;
